primary school guidance position, offsetting a new social worker
one second-grade teacher at the primary school (collapse six classrooms to five), offsetting a grade three teacher at Turkey Hill

statements.statement: Recommended FY22 school budget is a 2.5 percent increase, compared with 1.58 in FY21 and 3% in FY20.
Health insurance line down because of a premium holiday month; originally a 3% increase was out there and the reduction is why 2.5% is sought.
Governor's budget shows a very slight Chapter 70 increase, but an adjustment is possible because it used October 1 enrollment.
Town manager's proposed budget has a surplus, a significant portion recommended for the health insurance stabilization fund.

warnings.prediction: Non-personnel spending may rise sharply next year as health insurance is rebuilt, while personnel growth looks smaller.
Grant-funded positions may not all be sustainable after the federal funds end; some may not be needed.
